metrics.scope: Crossed history/label averaging, identical initial weights and common TRAIN-derived scale. All four arms share teacher generation. DEV evaluates finite independent continuation averages; bootstrap is prefix uncertainty conditional on fitted seed. Averaged TRAIN constant is the stronger common comparator; single TRAIN constant saved. Synthetic true-generator access is diagnostic, not a deployment capability. No actor weight updates or asynchronous learner.
metrics.gate: All three seeds must improve DEV calibration and intervention selection against averaged TRAIN constant before depth scaling; no automated scaling.

flop_scope: All shared teacher generation and four critic fits; supported PyTorch operations only, special/unsupported operations excluded. No work-to-quality claim.
